opennyai_summary.16_November_2023__decision:
This Crl.M.C is pending before this Court from 2019 onwards.
That interim order is extended continuously and that order is in force even now.
If that is the case, the petitioners can file discharge petition if the charge is not framed.
Therefore this Crl.M.C is disposed of with the following directions:
(a) The petitioners are free to file discharge petition before the trial court raising all the contentions raised in this Crl.M.C within 3 weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, if the charge is not framed.
(c) If such a discharge petition is filed as directed above, the learned Magistrate will not insist the personal appearance of the petitioners till discharge petition is considered.
